messages:
Alex: Quick sync: we need to pick a pattern to stitch late billing/tenant attrs for cost. Durable ledger vs ephemeral map service? tradeoffs?
Priya: Ledger = auditable, replayable. Ops cost + storage. Ephemeral map = simpler infra but loses history for audits.
Marco: Non-negotiable: no extra sync latency on ingest. Any persist must be async.
Sohail: Idea: hybrid - only persist when attrs missing (miss-capture). Most traces already have keys so write volume small.
ingest-bot: ingest-bot: sample ingest rates: regional p95 ~13k tps, p99 ~16k tps (2026-03-22T02:15Z).
Alex: Hybrid seems sensible. Implementation sketch: fast local miss emit -> async append into per-region ledger shards -> reconciler joins late attrs and writes final attribution to analytics.
Priya: Analytics change: add "provisional" flag + "finalized_at" in cost tables so dashboards can show drift.
Marco: Ops & SLOs: ledger compaction, retention (7d default), and alerts for backlog/compaction lag. Reconciler target: settle 90% in 24h, 99% in 72h.
Sohail: PoC tasks: Marco -> append perf harness. Priya -> analytics schema update. Alex -> RFC addendum with decision matrix and owners.
Alex: If PoC shows miss-write <5% of traces then land hybrid as default. Meeting Fri 10 to review. :thumbsup:
